posts.name: broccoli
posts.cooked:
The full text description of DW Setback from this wiki http://sentinelswiki.com/index.php?title=Setback is:

> While things deteriorated more and more in Rook City, the heroes who regularly patrolled the failing city grew increasingly concerned about the disappearance of Mr. Fixer. Three of the those heroes joined forces: Expatriette, Setback, and Nightmist. They worked together to protect Rook City and to investigate the loss of their friend.

When Amanda told Pete that they were going to team up, he had reservations. Of course, he was excited to help, but that was exactly the problem. He knew how things go for him - he didn't want Dark Watch to have any major setbacks. Even still, you can't help if you don't try, and Pete was very good at trying. When working with Dark Watch, Setback often leads the charge. He likes getting up close and personal with his opponents and also far enough away from his allies that he can't accidentally trip them up. Though he does like to spend as much time with Amanda as possible....

The hero team known as Dark Watch has gone through a lot. They were originally formed by Expatriette, Setback, and NightMist who were seeking to uncover the truth behind the events of the death of their friend, Mister Fixer. So, it was a bit of a rough start that the first major threat to Dark Watch was a mystically revived Mister Fixer! They managed to survive and even helped him reconnect his mind and body, so Mister Fixer became the fourth member of Dark Watch, fighting alongside those who risked everything to save him.

Based on that, I'm thinking something like Setback in the lead, along with Nightmist and Exp (possibly with someone in between them), but I'm curious about how to work in the Mister Fixer thing.  Part of me says he shouldn't be on the team, but another part says that we need to work in the resurrection somehow.  Hmmm.

posts.cooked:
DW expat's first incap (http://sentinelswiki.com/index.php?title=File:Darkwatchexpatrietteincap.jpg) is clearly happening on a Mobile Defense platform. Baron Blade may need to be in the game? Alternatively, since we know the Citizens take over the MDPs (one of the MDP cards that is not yet in the video game) Citizen Dawn may have to be the villian. 

 

Also, Adept is in the background, fighting I believe Empyreon. Empyreon is not yet in the video game, so can probably ignore that.

 

DW Expat is also sheilding setback, so redirecting damage to her that kills her, possibly against Blade or Dawn (possibly damage that would have killed setback) may be part of the requirements.

 

And her Unlock for DW Expat is against Blade in Rook city - because of the MDPs, I'm guessing. So with that in mind, the above become a bit more likely.

 

However, both the original DW expat incap and the new foil ones have Setback in his Dark Watch uniform - indiciating they are perhaps after the event needed.

 

In which case, we look to Setbacks incaps. His first version has him hanging up his suit - Silver lining back into play? Some other effect? Seems to be happening in Rook City.

 

The new version has him juggling vials and being electricuted (Shock rounds? He is Twitchy after all)  - that again looks like a MDP setup ( a shield generator, perhaps?)

 

 

 

I'd hazard a guess that its Setback, Expat, and Nightmist in Rook City against Blade or Dawn, redirecting damage to Expat from Setback that kills her

 

possibly also Setback, Expat, Nightmist against Any Villain, in Temple of Zhu (possibly the Chairman), with DW Mr Fixer already unlocked.

 

(remember dw fixers unlock is part of this story of the formation of the Dark Watch - and Omnitron U required Cosmic Omni to be unlocked already, so having a character already unlocked can be a requirement)

 

Possibly: Nightmist Expat Fixer Setback vrs The Chairman, in Temple of Zhu, Fixer must be incapped by the Operative and brought back to life. (which seems odd as it already includes the basic story of another unlockl
